text: しょうぶが　ごかくの　ときは　きもちが　つよい　ほうが　かつ！

structure.jp: しょうぶが　ごかくの　ときは
きもちが　つよい　ほうが
structure.en: the one whose will is stronger

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a description means 'when that is so'. ごかくの　ときは = 'when it is even'.

patterns.name: 〜ほうが (the one that)
patterns.span: きもちが　つよい　ほうが
patterns.explanation: ほう means 'side', so a description plus ほう picks out one of two. きもちが　つよい　ほうが = 'the one with the stronger will'.
